title: Effect of vasopressin versus norepinephrine on post-operative mean pulmonary arterial pressure following pulmonary endarterectomy surgery, a randomized open label trial
official: Effect of vasopressin versus norepinephrine on post-operative mean pulmonary arterial pressure following pulmonary endarterectomy surgery, a randomized open label trial
summary: Main objective: To compare the efficacy of vasopressin versus norepinephrine on the immediate post-operative reduction in mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) following pulmonary artery endarterectomy.

interventions.name: Reverpleg 40 U.I./2 ml solution à diluer pour perfusion
